blocks.text: The People Management Association of the Philippines (PMAP) ended its three-day Annual Conference at the Marriott Grand Ballroom on October 23, gathering over 1,400 participants in an event aimed at preparing the human resources (HR) industry for the constantly evolving work landscape. As the country’s premier people management gathering, the 63rd Annual Conference brought together influential workforce managers, HR executives, and global thought leaders for three days of conversation and exploration on the foundations of people operations.
